## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models EfficientNetB1-2
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/image_classification/efficientnet/EfficientNetB1-2/EfficientNetB1-2_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/EfficientNetB1-2.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_dog.jpg
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target EfficientNetB1-2_sync   # once
./bin/EfficientNetB1-2_sync \
  -m assets/models/EfficientNetB1-2.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_dog.jpg
```
